detail.q: Is R1 kneeling on all fours with his head bowed while R2 performs a headstand with her legs split wide, rather than R2 kneeling on all fours and R1 doing the split-leg headstand?
detail.evidence: left man kneels while center dancer headstands in splits

detail.q: Is R4 holding a back-bending headstand while R3 is kneeling on all fours, rather than R3 holding the back-bending headstand and R4 kneeling on all fours?
detail.evidence: right dancer back-bends while rear center dancer kneels

detail.q: Is R2 the dancer balancing upside down in the wide split-leg headstand, rather than R1 being the one in that inverted split-leg pose?
detail.evidence: center dancer is inverted with legs split wide

detail.q: Does R1 have the role of kneeling on all fours with his head bowed?
detail.evidence: R1 is on all fours with head lowered

detail.q: Does R4 have the role of holding a back-bending headstand?
detail.evidence: R4 holds the right-side back-bending headstand
